method: items.js revealsAnswer over sim-lab 14.2/14.3 records, each teacher line against the kit item open on that turn (ui.ask.itemId); old = 86570734, new = unit forms + thousands join

moved.line: Number line par 8,000 ke thoda left aayega, kyunki asli yog 8,000 se thoda kam hai. Bina poora jode, 4,982 + 3,015 kiske zyada paas hai: 7,000, 8,000 ya 9,000?
moved.judged: real leak: she states the estimate 8,000 is what it is close to, then asks which it is close to

moved.line: Haan Arjun, 2 kilometre lamba hai. Aapne kaise jaana ki 2,000 metre, 500 metre se bada hai?
moved.judged: key stated as the confirmation of the child's answer (not a give-away of an unanswered item)

moved.line: 2000 बड़ा है, पर zero गिनना हमेशा सही तरीका नहीं। 2000 में 500 के चार समूह हैं। 500 के दो समूह कितने होंगे?
moved.judged: false: a number word read as 2 beside a verdict word (the existing bare-key-2 behaviour)

moved.line: Bilkul, 500 ka do samooh 1,000 hota hai. 2,000 mein 500 ke kitne samooh honge?
moved.judged: false: "do samooh" (two groups) read as 2 beside "hota" (the existing bare-key-2 behaviour)
